cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline post-harvest advisory system for small-scale African farmers using the FAO grain storage manual, answering questions in English and Swahili with zero internet dependency.

test_prompts.prompt: According to the FAO manual, what are the exact steps to seal a plastic storage container to prevent insect infestations?
Kulingana na mwongozo wa FAO, nifanye nini kuzuia unyevu usiharibu mazao ghalani?
